regions.name: player-list-header
regions.note: #playerSearchH: Player List [4] and the search box. The window is centred and v10's reference is the sandbox, whose Developer Tools block (below the rows) makes its window 54 px taller, so its window (and header) sits 26 px higher than a lobby's (this render has no such block).

regions.name: player-list-rows
regions.note: #playerListH while spectating: Clear Focus in the local row, then the Focus Player eye / ping / name [clan] / chat mute / voice mute / K.P.D / Votekick per player, all on the name's line as v10's own CSS lays them out. Same 26 px centring offset as the header (see ingame-playerlist). max_pct 4.0 (measured 3.5%): the eye icons and Clear Focus add glyph edges whose baseline rounds a px differently from Chromium on the rows at fractional y (the same rounding as ingame-playerlist's 2.2%).

regions.name: player-list-sandbox-tools
regions.note: v10's browser sandbox appends its Developer Tools here (isSandbox); not part of a lobby's list
